text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan managed to deliver
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—This concludes the announcement for this year's
Uma Musume of the Year. Up next...”

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
This time, on the initiative of Tracen Academy's chairwoman,
a new award has been established for a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Because that Umamusume left such immense
contributions to the Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Curren Chan-san,
please come up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Certificate of Commendation!
Curren Chan, not only through races, but also via her tremendous success on social media, has invigorated the entire Umamusume world!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I present to you!
The "CC Award"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The CC Award"?
Wait, does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Announcing!
The 'Crown of Cuteness' Award!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...!
A crown of cuteness...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is so happy.
Thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro~ther!
Curren did it~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis~!
Curren did it!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Your brother?
Is one of your relatives visiting?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Older sister?
Are your relatives here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... we're connected on a level
just as deeeep as family♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she kept our hearts racing... Curren Chan
had truly become the most beloved Umamusume,
both in name and in reality!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“—Then, for our final question:
having received this Special Award today...”

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Curren-san, what is your next goal, straight up?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Of course, it's already decided♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like winning this award marks a milestone
in what I needed to achieve.
So, next...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of trying my luck out in the world!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want to go meet all the lucky people
who are about to meet the cute Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Curren will dash in a flash
anywhere to deliver cuteness♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's spread the circle of cute with Curren♪
Everyone~, just wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—When footage of this press conference aired,
'Curren' dominated the worldwide trending topics that day, and as a result..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother.
I'm all checked in!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis / Big brother.
All checked in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I was at the airport, fully prepared to take on the world...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Are you still half-asleep?
Jeez, pull yourself together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of a brand new day
on our path of cuteness, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
After cute comes supremely cute,
and after that is ultimate cute...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep chasing this endless dream,
wherever it leads♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren is certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I have you, Big Brother...
I can spread cuteness wherever I go."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That as long as Big Sis is with me...
I can spread cuteness anywhere and everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And besides!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"When I'm with you, Big Brother,
Curren can become the cutest in the whole universe, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, Big Sis,
Curren can become the cutest in the whole universe, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, Big Brother,
keep your eyes on Curren forever and ever, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, Onii-chan...
Keep your eyes only on Curren forever and ever, okay?♪
